children: to support its next chapter of growth, initiating a search for a new CEO following the departure of Carl Goyette as President and CEO.

Carl Goyette is concluding his tenure as President and CEO after 12 years with the company, including six years as CEO. Chairman Tyler Ricks has been appointed Executive Chair during the transition, while Goyette will remain on the Board of Directors as a director and shareholder.
Patrick Charbonneau, formerly Executive Vice President of Sales, has been promoted to Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), taking charge of all commercial sales activities.
During the interim period, CRO Patrick Charbonneau and COO/CFO Ingy Sarraf will co-lead daily operations, reporting directly to Executive Chair Tyler Ricks.

title: GURU Organic Energy announces CEO succession as Carl Goyette steps down; Tyler Ricks named Executive Chair
